items.summary: Hazelton's voter pamphlet statement says he would make SFUSD easier to join by reforming the lottery system and expanding wrap-around services; his site describes a proximity-based assignment system with integration goals built in.
items.title: Reform the enrollment lottery and expand wrap-around services

citations.quote: For Families: Make SFUSD easier to join by reforming the lottery system and expanding wrap-around services.
citations.locator: Candidate statement, Board of Education, p. 29 (PDF page 31)

citations.quote: Simplified enrollment — a proximity-based assignment system with integration goals built in, designed to reduce anxiety and increase predictability for every family
citations.locator: The Whole Child Agenda: For Families

items.summary: Hazelton's voter pamphlet statement says he would pay educators fairly and on time and ensure classrooms are well resourced.
items.title: Pay educators fairly and on time

citations.quote: For Educators: Pay them fairly and on-time and ensure that classrooms are well resourced.
citations.locator: Candidate statement, Board of Education, p. 29 (PDF page 31)

items.summary: Hazelton's voter pamphlet statement lists addressing chronic absenteeism; his site says it should be addressed at root causes such as housing instability, health access and school belonging rather than through punitive policies.
items.title: Address chronic absenteeism at its root causes

citations.quote: For Students: Address chronic absenteeism - children cannot learn if they aren’t in schools.
citations.locator: Candidate statement, Board of Education, p. 29 (PDF page 31)

citations.quote: Chronic absenteeism — addressed at the root causes of housing instability, health access, and school belonging, not through punitive policies that push families further away
citations.locator: The Whole Child Agenda: For Children
